reference_image_role: L0-0003A is the architectural and photographic continuity reference
continuity_assessment: The camera clears the broad offset into a shallow bay. Near walls frame a single carpet route around the central wall, with the same wall finish, carpet, ceiling grid, lighting family, eye height, and lens.
known_drift: The curved wall recedes and the central offset becomes more rectilinear, but moderate openness and the receding fluorescent line preserve the branch identity.
